h1: Boxotel — a quiet shipping-container loft resort in Maha Sarakham on a budget
intro: Want a design-led place to stay in Maha Sarakham without paying much? Boxotel in Waeng Nang, Mueang district, is a small boutique resort that turns shipping containers into guest rooms, mixed with loft-style units · What reviewers mention most is how quiet and clean it is — spacious rooms, comfortable beds, and motel-style parking right outside your door · Prices start from approx. ฿550/night and it holds a strong score of 9.4 from 24 reviews on Trip.com — outstanding for this price bracket.

body.html: Boxotel sits at 95-96 Moo 15, Waeng Nang sub-district, Mueang Maha Sarakham, and has been open since 2020 — the concept is to turn shipping containers into guest rooms, mixed with bare-concrete loft-style units, giving you a modern-looking stay at a budget price · It's a small resort laid out motel-style so you can park right outside your room, with easy access in and out — handy for self-drive travellers as well as parents dropping students at Mahasarakham University.

Rooms come in Standard and Deluxe with a king bed — and guests agree they're more spacious than expected and very clean, scoring as high as 9.8 on cleanliness · Every room has air conditioning, a flat-screen TV, a fridge, drinking water, a table and chairs, a private bathroom and a small private balcony to catch the breeze · Some rooms add a seating sofa, which makes the space feel roomier than most rooms at the same price · There's free Wi-Fi, a small garden and common areas to sit out in.
"Everything's simple, the room is spacious and clean, and it's so quiet, comfy bed, easy parking right by the door, the owner and staff look after you well — great value."

What earns a small place a score as high as 9.4 is the peace and quiet · One review calls it the most quiet hotel they've stayed at in the city, which suits anyone who just wants to rest properly after a long drive or a day of errands in town · The motel-style layout feels private — no walking through a shared lobby like a tower hotel · There are local eateries and convenience stores within walking distance, and it's a short drive to Maha Sarakham town and the university.

To be honest — this is a small, pared-back place, not a full-facility resort · There's no pool, and some platforms list no breakfast service, so check with the property if you need it · One review mentions some fixtures are getting old — the shower, lighting and air conditioning — understandable for a resort that's been open a few years · The location is in Waeng Nang on the edge of town, so having your own car is the most convenient way to get around, as it isn't right in the central market area.

In short, Boxotel suits anyone after a design-led, clean, quiet, low-cost stay with drive-to-door parking in Maha Sarakham · Set your expectations right — a small, simple resort focused on a good bed and quiet, not a full-facility hotel — and it delivers more than its price suggests, with that 9.4 from 24 reviews confirming most people who stayed here left happy.

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Boxotel, Maha Sarakham

faq.q: Where is Boxotel in Maha Sarakham?
faq.a: It's at 95-96 Moo 15, Waeng Nang sub-district, Mueang Maha Sarakham · It's on the edge of town, an easy drive to Mahasarakham University, the town centre and the night market — having your own car is the most convenient way to get around.

faq.q: What kind of place is Boxotel?
faq.a: It's a small boutique resort of shipping-container rooms mixed with loft-style units, open since 2020 · The motel-style layout lets you park outside your room, with Standard and Deluxe king rooms that include AC, a fridge, a flat-screen TV and a private balcony.

faq.q: What's the starting price and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿550/night for a Standard room · There's also a more spacious Deluxe, some with a seating sofa · Rates vary by season, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Is there breakfast or a pool at Boxotel?
faq.a: There's no pool, as this is a small resort focused on clean rooms and quiet · Breakfast depends on the package and some platforms list no service, so check with the property before booking · There are local eateries and convenience stores within walking distance.

faq.q: Why does Boxotel score so highly?
faq.a: Because the rooms are very clean (9.8 cleanliness) and quiet · One review calls it the most quiet place they've stayed in the city; rooms are spacious, beds are comfortable, and the owner and staff look after guests well — adding up to 9.4 from 24 reviews.

It's best for anyone wanting a design-led, clean, quiet, low-cost stay with drive-to-door parking · It's ideal for parents dropping a student at Mahasarakham University or self-drive travellers, and less suited to those wanting a central-town location or big-hotel facilities.
